desc: Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith public notice confirming the dispatch of the Notice of 5th Annual General Meeting (post IPO) ('AGM') and Annual Report for FY26 of the Company published on September 4, 2026, in Businessline & Trinity Mirror (English newspapers) and Makkal Kural (Tamil newspaper).
